'''Dean''' is one of the Four Heroes of Palmyna who fought in order to defeat one of the Four Fallen Gods, {{c|Cardes}} the Malevolent.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Dean's first appearance is in [[GQ:Palmyna|Grand Quest - Four Heroes of Palmyna]].

==Background==
Dean is portrayed as the quartet's comic relief due to his personality. Despite being a priest, his attitude is somewhat disrespectful, such as calling Lorand as "Gramps". and offends Loch at times. But despite all of his, he is still considered as a friend and ally to Princess Edea of Palmyna.
